critical_interpretation: This is the verified published AMP-Glo method. It offers different detection chemistry from Page MG, but the publications do not constitute a matched, locally qualified orthogonal assay pair.

The 500 nM TH5427 anchor is a published normalization convention, not evidence that it achieves complete inhibition for every construct, enzyme, or future assay condition. Its suitability requires independent verification.
Normalization to 0% and 100% controls does not establish whether a fitted IC50 is a free-top/free-bottom relative midpoint or the absolute control-defined 50%-activity crossing.
NUDT5 and NUDT14 reaction times differ. Reported IC50 ratios are not automatically matched-kinetic selectivity estimates, binding KD, or thermodynamic selectivity.
A fall in AMP-Glo luminescence can reflect reporter/coupling interference; AMP-Glo needs detection-only controls and independently interpretable product or binding evidence.

guidance_observed: Relative IC50 is the concentration at the midpoint of the fitted Top and Bottom. It need not coincide with 50% on an independently control-normalized activity axis.
Absolute IC50 denotes a control-defined halfway response; GraphPad notes this terminology is not entirely standard. Baseline defining 0% and the fitted Bottom are different quantities.
If the dose-response stays above the control-defined 50% level, the absolute IC50 is undefined even if the relative midpoint can be estimated.
The page provides absolute-IC50 fitting equations, distinguishes Bottom from Baseline, and advises fixing Baseline using control measurements; it also discusses Top constraints.
references.actual_method_conditions: Statistical guidance, not a NUDT5 experimental protocol. No enzyme, buffer, incubation, reporter-validation or potency acceptance thresholds are supplied for this project.
references.application_to_this_task: Prespecify the potency estimand and response normalization, document whether Top/Bottom are fitted or constrained, retain maximum effect and uncertainty, and label an undefined/unbracketed absolute endpoint instead of substituting a relative midpoint or a fitted extrapolation.
access_and_evidence_limits: Full HTML text was retrieved; figures/linked Prism example file were not separately downloaded.

guidance_and_actual_conditions_observed: Artifacts are changes in assay signal unrelated to the biological target/pathway. The chapter distinguishes reporter interference from genuine off-target biology such as cytotoxicity.

Orthogonal assays aim to preserve the biological question while changing an independent detection component. A counterscreen seeks detector interference; a negative counterscreen alone does not establish target activity, and a positive orthogonal result alone does not establish the desired mechanism.

For biochemical luciferase detection, the published control concept is to run reaction to completion or add excess product without the target enzyme, then add detection reagents and test compounds for effects on the detection reaction. No universal product concentration or NUDT5-specific acceptance band is stated.

Reporter inhibitors can give decreased luminescence directly or increased/bell-shaped responses in cell-based reporter assays through ligand-based reporter stabilization and detection-reagent effects. Signal direction alone is not proof of biology.
The chapter recommends orthogonal reporters and notes detector variants/formulations differ in inhibitor susceptibility. Less susceptible does not mean interference-proof.
references.application_to_this_task: A proposed AMP-spike/no-NUDT5 AMP-Glo control is an adaptation of this published detection-control principle, not a performed or source-validated NUDT5 protocol. Complement it with appropriately qualified MG/product-detection controls and a non-shared detection method; separately check any cellular nuclear-ATP reporter and general cell effects.

not_permitted_inferences: Do not call a numerical fit biologically validated because software converges.
Do not replace undefined absolute IC50 with relative IC50 without changing the estimand label.
Do not treat a control-normalized zero as experimentally proven zero activity without independent support.
Do not equate a reported >50 micromolar bound, a missing assay, a decoy label, and measured inactivity.
Do not promote published potency/QC numbers to local go/no-go thresholds, or claim a lab passed a gate.
Do not promote retrospective source/MRK results, literature remeasurement, or SOFTWARE TESTS ONLY synthetic data to new prospective biological evidence.
